stories.title: Musk and Altman to face off over the future of OpenAI in trial
stories.summary: In Oakland, a case is getting underway in which Elon Musk and Sam Altman will face off over the future of OpenAI, one of the world's most influential AI companies.

stories.title: 50,000 protestors were arrested in Iran. Some are facing the death penalty
stories.summary: Some 50,000 people were arrested in Iran during the anti-regime protests that led up to the Iran war.  Most are still in prisons and their families get little to no information about them.

stories.title: Mic malfunction leads to 'O Canada' sing along
stories.summary: In Buffalo, N.Y., Tuesday night, the Sabres faced off against the Boston Bruins. The microphone malfunctioned during the singing of the Canadian anthem, but the crowd stepped up.

stories.title: Dirty nickel: The health costs of mining in Indonesia
stories.summary: Indonesia is in the midst of a nickel boom, but there are concerns about how the mineral is mined and refined, and about its cost to the environment and local health.

stories.title: How a Republican state lawmaker tried to let Holocaust deniers hijack history lessons
stories.summary: A New Hampshire Republican. A German Holocaust denier. A suspicious bottle of baby oil. An NPR investigation reveals how the alarming rise of antisemitic conspiracy theories reached a state capitol.

stories.title: Families sue OpenAI over Canadian mass shooter's use of ChatGPT
stories.summary: The lawsuits claim OpenAI was negligent for failing to report the shooter to authorities after her account was flagged for "gun violence activity and planning."
